name: Lightweight Transport Wheelchair
summary: A folding wheelchair that weighs under 34 pounds, with swing-away footrests and a padded seat.
description:
A lightweight wheelchair for people who can propel themselves for short distances or are pushed by a caregiver. The frame folds flat to fit in most car trunks, and the footrests swing away so getting in and out is easier.

We set the seat height, footrest length and brakes for you at delivery, and show your caregiver how to fold, lift and store it.
specs:
Weight: 33 lb without footrests
Seat width: 18 in
Seat depth: 16 in
Weight capacity: 300 lb
Folded width: 12 in
Rear wheels: 24 in, quick release
whats_included:
Wheelchair frame
Swing-away footrests
Seat cushion
Anti-tip bars
price_note: Self-pay from $45 a month to rent

name: Four-Wheel Rollator with Seat
summary: A walker with four wheels, hand brakes, a padded seat and a basket, for people who need support but tire easily.
description:
A rollator gives you the support of a walker with wheels that roll smoothly indoors and out. When you need a break, lock the brakes and sit on the padded seat.

We adjust the handle height to your wrist crease and show you how to use the brakes safely on slopes.
specs:
Weight: 15 lb
Seat height: 21 in
Handle height: 31 to 37 in
Weight capacity: 300 lb
Wheels: 8 in, indoor and outdoor

name: Knee Scooter
summary: A steerable knee scooter for foot and ankle recovery, so you can stay off crutches.
description:
After foot or ankle surgery, a knee scooter lets you rest your lower leg on a padded platform and push with your good foot. It steers like a bicycle and has a hand brake.

Most people rent for four to eight weeks. We can pick it up when you are back on your feet.
specs:
Weight: 21 lb
Knee pad height: 18 to 24 in
Weight capacity: 300 lb
Turning radius: 3 ft
Folds for transport
price_note: Self-pay from $35 a week to rent

name: Home Oxygen Concentrator
summary: A quiet stationary concentrator that delivers up to 5 liters per minute of oxygen at home, around the clock.
description:
An oxygen concentrator pulls oxygen from room air, so there are no tanks to refill at home. This model runs quietly enough for a bedroom and alerts you if the oxygen level or power drops.

A respiratory therapist sets your prescribed flow, fits your tubing and cannula, and leaves backup cylinders in case of a power cut. We check on you after the first week and service the unit on a schedule.
specs:
Flow: 0.5 to 5 liters per minute
Oxygen purity: 87 to 96 percent
Sound level: about 40 dB
Power use: 300 W
Weight: 31 lb
whats_included:
Concentrator
Nasal cannula and 25 ft tubing
Humidifier bottle
Backup oxygen cylinders

name: Portable Oxygen Concentrator
summary: A battery-powered concentrator for errands and travel, approved for use on most airlines.
description:
A portable concentrator lets you leave home without carrying tanks. It runs on a rechargeable battery and plugs into the car or a wall outlet. Most airlines accept it on board.

We help you check whether it meets your prescription, because portable units deliver oxygen in pulses rather than a continuous flow.
specs:
Delivery: pulse dose, settings 1 to 5
Battery: up to 4.5 hours on setting 2
Weight: 5 lb with battery
Airline use: FAA approved
whats_included:
Portable concentrator
Battery
Carry bag
AC and car chargers

name: CPAP System with Heated Humidifier
summary: An auto-adjusting CPAP machine with a heated humidifier, mask fitting and sleep data your doctor can read.
description:
CPAP treats obstructive sleep apnea by keeping your airway open while you sleep. This machine adjusts pressure through the night and records how well therapy is working, which many insurance plans ask for.

Our respiratory team fits your mask in person, sets the machine to your prescription, and calls you in the first weeks to help with comfort.
specs:
Pressure: 4 to 20 cm H2O, auto-adjusting
Humidifier: heated, 5 levels
Sound level: about 26 dB
Data: wireless reporting to your care team
whats_included:
CPAP machine
Heated humidifier
Mask fitted in person
6 ft heated tubing
Filters

name: Compressor Nebulizer
summary: A compact nebulizer that turns liquid medicine into a fine mist for asthma and COPD treatments.
description: A nebulizer delivers inhaled medicine through a mouthpiece or mask over about ten minutes. This compressor is small enough for a bedside table and easy to clean.
specs:
Treatment time: about 8 to 12 minutes
Sound level: about 55 dB
Weight: 3 lb
whats_included:
Compressor
Reusable nebulizer kit
Adult and child masks
Tubing and filters

name: Semi-Electric Hospital Bed
summary: A full-size home hospital bed with electric head and foot adjustment, side rails and a mattress.
description:
A hospital bed makes it easier to sit up, get in and out, and receive care at home. The head and foot sections adjust with a hand control, and the height adjusts with a crank.

We deliver, assemble and place the bed, take away the packaging and show you and your caregivers how to use the rails safely.
specs:
Size: 36 by 80 in
Weight capacity: 350 lb
Head and foot: electric
Height: manual crank, 15 to 23 in
Rails: half length
whats_included:
Bed frame
Innerspring mattress
Half-length side rails
Hand control

name: Alternating Pressure Mattress
summary: A powered air mattress that shifts pressure every few minutes to help prevent and heal pressure injuries.
description: For people who spend most of the day in bed, an alternating pressure mattress inflates and deflates rows of air cells in turn, so no part of the body takes pressure for long.
specs:
Cells: 20 alternating air cells
Cycle: about 10 minutes
Weight capacity: 350 lb
Fits standard 36 by 80 in beds
whats_included:
Air mattress
Pump with alarm
Cover

name: Shower Chair with Back
summary: A sturdy, height-adjustable shower chair with a backrest and non-slip feet.
description: Sitting to shower reduces the risk of falls and helps people with limited stamina keep their independence. The legs adjust in one-inch steps and the seat drains quickly.
specs:
Seat height: 16 to 21 in
Weight capacity: 300 lb
Tool-free assembly

name: Raised Toilet Seat with Arms
summary: Adds about five inches of height to a standard toilet, with padded arms for support.
description: A raised seat makes sitting down and standing up easier after hip or knee surgery, or for anyone with limited strength. It locks onto most standard toilets without tools.
specs:
Height added: 5 in
Weight capacity: 300 lb
Fits standard and elongated bowls

name: Tub Transfer Bench
summary: A bench that straddles the side of the tub, so you can sit down outside and slide across safely.
description: A transfer bench removes the need to step over the side of the tub. You sit down outside, lift your legs over and slide across.
specs:
Length: 34 in
Seat height: 17 to 22 in
Weight capacity: 400 lb

name: Hydraulic Patient Lift
summary: A mobile lift with a full-body sling, so one caregiver can move a person from bed to chair safely.
description:
A patient lift protects both the person being moved and the caregiver. A hydraulic pump raises the sling, and the base widens to fit around chairs and commodes.

Every lift delivery includes hands-on training until your caregivers are comfortable using it.
specs:
Lifting capacity: 400 lb
Base: adjustable width
Sling: full body, size fitted at delivery

name: Power Lift Recliner
summary: A recliner that gently tilts forward to help you stand, with a simple hand control.
description: A lift chair raises and tilts you forward to a standing position, which helps people with arthritis or weak leg muscles stand on their own. Medicare covers the lift mechanism when it is medically necessary; the chair itself is self-pay.
specs:
Weight capacity: 325 lb
Positions: infinite recline
Upholstery: wipe-clean fabric

name: Blood Glucose Meter
summary: An easy-to-read glucose meter with a large display and a memory of the last 500 results.
description: Accurate home testing helps you and your doctor manage diabetes. This meter needs a tiny blood sample and gives a result in five seconds.
specs:
Result time: 5 seconds
Memory: 500 results
Display: large backlit numbers

name: Glucose Test Strips
summary: Test strips for your meter, shipped automatically every month or every three months.
description: We bill your plan and ship strips before you run out. You can change the schedule or quantity at any time by calling the order desk.
specs:
Pack size: 50 strips per box
Shipping: monthly or every 90 days
